Maya (CSM): Morning — quick check on Anchorage private deploy. We're blocked on outbound egress to Redwood and a KMS key policy rejecting encrypt calls. Need owners and ETA. @Sam can you confirm?
Sam (Anchorage-IT): Morning. I see blocked attempts in our FW logs to 18.205.x.x. I can open egress but want the exact IP/CIDR list. Also the CMK was created with kms:Encrypt only for role A123 — do you have the principal we should add?
Ravi (NetEng): @Sam we'll need outbound to these CIDRs for now: 18.205.0.0/16 and 34.201.0.0/16 (Redwood hosted). Also allow TCP 443 outbound for health checks. I'll push a transit-gw route for 10.250.0.0/16 -> Redwood peering.
Jules (Solutions): KMS principal = arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-service. Minimal policy snippet (paste):
```
{
  "Sid": "AllowRedwoodEncrypt",
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-service"},
  "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey*"],
  "Resource": "*"
}
```
Olivia (SecEng): Heads-up — avoid posting full ARNs in public threads. @Sam please confirm CMK alias/origin and whether key policy lockbox is enabled. Also we need audit logs forwarded to their Splunk ingest endpoint — what do you have for that?
Sam (Anchorage-IT): CMK alias = alias/anchorage/redwood, created in us-east-2. We'll grant the role but route audit logs to s3://anchorage-audit then forward to Splunk via Kinesis. Splunk ingest: https://ingest.anchorage.example/splunk
Maya (CSM): Summary action items: (1) @Sam add CIDRs + allow TCP 443 outbound; (2) @Sam update KMS key policy to include role from Jules (I'll DM the exact ARN); (3) @Ravi create transit gw route and confirm in 30m; (4) @Olivia verify audit-forwarding posture and approve retention. Cutover target = 2026-05-12. Quick note: if cutover slips >2 weeks, renewal conversation becomes higher priority — flagging risk early.
Ravi (NetEng): Route pushed — transit-gw tgw-0a1b2c3d now has 10.250.0.0/16 -> peering. Ping me if BGP doesn't show the route.
deploy-bot: Firewall rule request #8721 created by Sam — status: pending review.
Sam (Anchorage-IT): I updated the key policy and added the CIDRs. Can someone from Redwood confirm KMS calls succeed? I ran a small test and previously got 403s.
Jules (Solutions): Running an encrypt test from our harness... ✅ Success. Also health checks started passing after the route update.
Olivia (SecEng): Audit-forwarding test: received 3 events in s3://anchorage-audit and Splunk ingest shows events. Retention set to 90 days per customer's ask — security ok for now. I'll file a compliance ticket with details.
Maya (CSM): Thanks everyone. I'll update the enablement doc and close blockers once @Sam confirms post-cutover ops review. Proposed: 1-week ops review after cutover. If that's good I'll mark account health = green and resume renewal cadence.
Sam (Anchorage-IT): 1-week ops review works for us. Appreciate the help — thanks team :tada:
